title: Ops Sculptor: convert admin utilities into typed task pipelines
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Introduce Ops Sculptor: a lightweight pipeline authoring system that transforms existing ad-hoc admin scripts and runbook steps into typed, reusable task pipelines with guardrails. Goal is to reduce on-call cognitive load and enable first-line support to run safe repairs without deep host-level knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Author a pipeline from a three-step runbook (collect, patch, validate) via CLI and web UI
Each pipeline step exposes typed inputs and validation schemas
Pipelines run in sandbox mode producing telemetry and dry-run diff output
Integration with RBAC: only allowed roles may execute production-run pipelines
Audit events emitted to existing admin-audit pipeline and visible in Console traces
design_notes: We will represent steps as JSONL tasks with a small DSL to declare inputs, outputs, and pre/post checks
Prefer existing admin-worker sidecar to execute low-privilege steps; escalate to escalator when a step needs elevated rights
UI will reuse Console 'quickrun' surface but add input schemas and example presets
Telemetry tags: pipeline.id, pipeline.version, step.index, dry_run true/false, executor.hostpool
decisions: Use typed input schemas (JSON Schema subset) instead of inventing protobufs to keep authoring fast
Sandbox dry-run will execute read-only code paths and capture API call diffs rather than mutate state
Store pipeline manifests in a dedicated GitHub repo (ops-sculptor/manifests) for auditability and PR-based reviews
implementation_plan: MVP CLI: scaffold -> validate -> dry-run -> submit (week 1-2)
Executor adapter: admin-worker sidecar shim that reads manifest, validates inputs, executes with timeouts (week 2-3)
Console integration: input form + run history + artifacts link (week 3-4)
RBAC gating and audit plumbing with security team review (parallel)
Canary rollout to internal SRE team, collect telemetry and iterate (week 5)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: author error can cause destructive actions - Mitigation: require explicit two-step confirmation and production role check
Risk: telemetry gaps hide silent failures - Mitigation: enforce step-level event emission and add alerts for missing events
Risk: long-running steps block autoscaling - Mitigation: executor enforces step timeouts and heartbeat-based liveness
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest schema validation and CLI argument parsing
Integration tests that run pipelines against canned staging clusters (read-only and dry-run)
Chaos scenario: injected executor failures to ensure pipeline resumes or safely aborts
Security review tests: attempt privilege escalation from sandbox-allowed steps
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal SRE + Oncall rotation (opt-in) - monitor error rate and latency
Beta: broaden to support-rotation and a handful of product teams
GA: enable for Engineers with 'ops:run' grant and expose templated pipelines in Console
rollback_plan: Disable production execution via feature flag (Console + CLI will show read-only mode)
Revert manifests in ops-sculptor/manifests repo and revoke recently granted 'ops:run' roles
Postmortem and revert executor changes if we observe systemic impact
